description: Derives the esse-cause bridge: a cause c, distinct from an actual concretum x, of x's esse is concrete (causal-capacity premise) and exists at w (only actual things cause esse), so it is an actual concretum; x depends for its being on c (q.44 a.1 ad 2 read for causes of esse); and dependence between actual concreta is grounding. Four OPEN premises; the dependence bridge carries only one direction.
